description: Plan my meals for the week. Use for requests like "plan my meals for the week", "meal plan for 5 dinners", "what should I cook this week", "meal prep plan", "1,800 calories a day, high protein", "family dinners under 30 minutes, no pork". Picks breakfasts, lunches, dinners and snacks from a tested US recipe collection that fit the diet (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, keto, low-carb, high-protein), allergies and foods to avoid, cook time and number of people, and scales portions to a daily calorie goal. Calories and macros come from USDA FoodData Central, never estimated. Returns a day-by-day plan plus a plan_id; then call build_shopping_list with the plan_id for the grocery list and checkout link.

daily_calories.description: Calorie goal per person per day, e.g. 2000. Portions are scaled to hit it.

days.description: How many days to plan (1-7). '5 dinners' = days 5, meals ['dinner'].

diet.description: Diet preferences every meal must satisfy.

exclude.description: Foods to leave out, in plain words: "pork", "shellfish", "dairy", "gluten", "peanuts", "mushrooms", "cilantro". Matches allergen tags and ingredient names.

max_cook_minutes.description: Max total prep + cook time per meal, e.g. 30 for quick weeknight meals.

meals.description: Which meals to plan each day.

people.description: How many people you're cooking for (scales the grocery list).

seed.description: Change to get a different plan with the same constraints.

name: plan_week

portion.description: Servings per person for this meal (scaled to the calorie goal).

plan_id.description: Pass to build_shopping_list to get the grocery list and checkout link.

title: Weekly Meal Planner
